summary: Administrators with spaces or accents in their name can sign in again, and you can remove a delegation right on the Access map.

new.title: Remove a delegation on the Access map
new.text: Click an existing link on the Access map, confirm by name, and the removal is staged until you commit it on Review & Save. Click again to undo.

fixes.title: Sign-in works for every name
fixes.text: Administrators whose display name contains a space or an accented letter could not sign in. Install this version and sign-in works; nothing changes in your tenant.

fixes.title: "Cannot be deleted" names the blockers
fixes.text: Deleting a group still in use now lists each delegation in plain words and opens exactly those rows, so you can remove them first.

fixes.title: Search finds group tags
fixes.text: Review current delegations now finds group tags too. When nothing matches, it explains the difference and offers to search the Access map.

fixes.title: Clearer audit trail entries
fixes.text: A sign-in is now one readable sentence instead of fields reading "(none)".

fixes.title: PIM Manager's own group is not drift
fixes.text: The administrators group the deployment creates for PIM Manager itself is no longer reported as drift. The page says what was left out.
